children.value: The NYQM working group, Concern for Quaker Living (CQL) invites you to a Meeting for Eating! It’s a potluck! Bring your favorite dish! Spill the tea on strength and joy. Let's hear your thoughts and talents. More spiritual resiliency, health, Light, love and connection in 2024!
We ask that you test negative for COVID before this event.
